answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 14996 Country: India Title: Assalamoalaikum. Eating 'Kalonji' is Sunnat, and is said to be the medicine of all the illnesses. please tell me the quantity of 'Kalonji' to be taken in a day. Question: Assalamoalaikum. Eating 'Kalonji' is Sunnat, and is said to be the medicine of all the illnesses. please tell me the quantity of 'Kalonji' to be taken in a day. Answer ID: 14996 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1654/1324=H/1430) You can take 10 grains in the morning, 10 in the evening and 10 while going to bed. But, it is better to consult any expert hakim and get a prescription as per your physical conditions. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
